title: The Sleeping Room
author: Ada Underhill
blurb: Sebastian Sterling, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
